reference: He insisted that he was buying the hat only for the photo.
sk: Tvrdil, že si ten klobúk kupuje len na fotku
cz: Tvrdil, že si ten klobouk kupuje jen na fotku
acceptable: He {insisted|claimed} {that|} he was buying {the|that} hat {only|just} for {the|a} {photo|picture}.
He {insisted|claimed} {that|} he was {only|just} buying {the|that} hat for {the|a} {photo|picture}.

mistakes.text: He {insisted|claimed} {that |}he is buying the hat {only|just} for the photo.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po minulom „insisted“ sa čas zvyčajne posúva: „he was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po minulém „insisted“ se čas obvykle posouvá: „he was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After past “insisted”, the tense usually moves back: “he was buying”.

mistakes.text: He {insisted|claimed} {that |}he bought the hat {only|just} for the photo.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Continuous
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Kupuje“ je dej v priebehu, po backshifte Past Continuous: „was buying“. „Bought“ znamená, že už kúpil.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Kupuje“ je děj v průběhu, po backshiftu Past Continuous: „was buying“. „Bought“ znamená, že už koupil.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Kupuje” is in progress, so after backshift use the Past Continuous “was buying”; “bought” means it was done.

mistakes.text: He {insisted|claimed} {that |}he buys the hat {only|just} for the photo.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ide o dej v priebehu a po minulom slovese: treba Past Continuous „was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Jde o děj v průběhu po minulém slovese: je potřeba Past Continuous „was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action is in progress and reported after a past verb: use the Past Continuous “was buying”.

mistakes.text: He insisted on buying the hat {only|just} for the photo.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Insisted on buying“ znamená, že trval na kúpe. „Tvrdil, že“ je „insisted that he was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Insisted on buying“ znamená, že trval na koupi. „Tvrdil, že“ je „insisted that he was buying“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Insisted on buying” means he demanded to buy it; here use “insisted that he was buying”.

mistakes.text: He {insisted|claimed} {that |}he was buying the hat {only|just} on the photo.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Na fotku“ (za účelom) je „for the photo“, nie „on the photo“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Na fotku“ (za účelem) je „for the photo“, ne „on the photo“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a purpose, use “for the photo”, not “on the photo”.

mistakes.text: He {insisted|claimed} {that |}he was buying hat {only|just} for the photo.
